items.raw_excerpt: James Walsh pops the question to girlfriend Paige Cook in a "unique and memorable" setting.
items.summary_en: James Walsh asked girlfriend Paige Cook to marry him in a unique and memorable setting. The couple is a diving fan. The proposal happened at sea near the coast of England.

items.raw_excerpt: The hosepipe ban for 13 counties has been lifted with immediate effect, two weeks earlier than planned.
items.summary_en: The hose pipe ban for 13 counties in Ireland has been lifted immediately. The ban ended two weeks earlier than planned.

items.raw_excerpt: Dingle has the oldest population for a small town in Ireland.That’s according to figures released from the CSO’s Population, Distributions and Movements report...
items.summary_en: Dingle has the oldest population of any small town in Ireland. This comes from figures in a new CSO report on population and movements.

items.raw_excerpt: Bengaluru police plan to shift 11,346 seized vehicles from stations to clear space and improve pedestrian safety.
items.summary_en: Police in Bengaluru plan to move 11,346 seized vehicles out of station grounds. The move is meant to free up space and make walking safer. The vehicles have been clogging police stations across the city.
items.summary_ko: 인도 벵갈루루 경찰이 경찰서에 쌓여 있는 압수 차량 1만1346대를 다른 곳으로 옮길 계획이다. 경찰서 공간을 확보하고 보행 안전을 높이기 위해서다. 이 차량들은 도시 곳곳 경찰서를 오랫동안 가득 채우고 있었다.
items.title_en: Bengaluru police to move 11,346 seized vehicles
items.title_ko: 벵갈루루 경찰, 압수 차량 1만1346대 옮긴다
items.title_original: 11,346 seized vehicles clogging Bengaluru police stations to be shifted

items.raw_excerpt: To mark its tenth anniversary, the Talent Portugal Summit will be holding an edition in 2026, with the event taking place on 22 September at the Casa da Arquitetura in Matosinhos and on 29 September at the LISPOLIS Technology Forum in Lisbon.
items.summary_en: The Talent Portugal Summit will hold its 2026 edition to mark its tenth anniversary. It takes place on 22 September at Casa da Arquitetura in Matosinhos and on 29 September at the LISPOLIS Technology Forum in Lisbon. The event connects companies with higher education.
items.summary_ko: 탈렌트 포르투갈 서밋이 10주년을 맞아 2026년 행사를 연다. 행사는 9월 22일 마토시뉴스의 카사 다 아르키테투라와 9월 29일 리스본의 리스폴리스 테크놀로지 포럼에서 열린다. 기업과 고등교육을 잇는 자리다.
items.title_en: Talent Portugal Summit marks 10 years with events in Matosinhos and Lisbon
items.title_ko: 탈렌트 포르투갈 서밋, 10주년 맞아 마토시뉴스와 리스본에서 개최
items.title_original: Talent Portugal Summit celebrates a decade by connecting companies and higher education

items.raw_excerpt: Las hermanas Melita y Antonia Abraham confirmaron su favoritismo en el remo de los Juegos Sudamericanos de Santa Fe 2026 y este martes sumaron su primera medalla de oro en el remo. Las oriundas de Concepción se adjudicaron con talento y solidez la prueba dos sin timonel (W2-) y sumaron así la séptima medalla de oro para el Team Chile en la cita polideportiva que se realiza en Argentina.
items.summary_en: Rowers Melita and Antonia Abraham won gold in the women's coxless pair event at the South American Games in Santa Fe. The sisters, from Concepcion, finished first with steady technique. It is Chili7's seventh gold medal of the competition.
items.summary_ko: 조정 선수 멜리타와 안토니아 아브라함 자매가 산타페에서 열린 남아메리카 스포츠 대회에서 여자 조정 무타페어 금메달을 차지했습니다. 콘셉시온 출신 두 선수는 꾸준한 조정 실력으로 우승을 확정했습니다. 이번 금메달은 이번 대회에서 칠레 대표팀이 받은 일곱 번째 금메달입니다.
items.title_en: Abraham sisters win first rowing gold at South American Games
items.title_ko: 아브라함 자매, 남미 대회 조정에서 금메달
items.title_original: Las hermanas Abraham sumaron el séptimo oro del Team Chile en los Sudamericanos

items.raw_excerpt: Destinations across Spain have famously been suffering from overtourism, but there are still many cities in the country that have been overlooked and aren't packed with holidaymakers.
items.summary_en: Many destinations in Spain are crowded with too many tourists. Still, some cities stay quiet and are mostly missed by foreign visitors. A new list names nine of these underrated places.
items.summary_ko: 스페인의 여러 관광지가 너무 많은 관광객으로 붐빈다. 그래도 아직 한적하고 외국인에게 잘 알려지지 않은 도시들이 남아 있다. 이런 숨은 도시 아홉 곳을 한 목록으로 소개한다.
items.title_en: Nine underrated cities in Spain that foreign tourists overlook
items.title_ko: 외국인 관광객이 모르고 지나치는 스페인의 숨은 도시 아홉 곳
items.title_original: Nine underrated cities in Spain overlooked by foreign tourists

items.raw_excerpt: The Associacao Ecologista e Zoofila de Aljezur (AEZA, www.aeza.org) was celebrating this week, following the success of its first ever open afternoon on Sunday 6th of September.
items.summary_en: A cat shelter in Aljezur held its first open afternoon on Sunday, September 6th. The event went well and the local animal protection group is celebrating.
items.summary_ko: 알제주르의 고양이 보호소가 지난 9월 6일 일요일 처음으로 연 오픈 데이 행사를 성공적으로 마쳤다. 지역 동물 보호 단체가 그 소식을 기쁘게 축하하고 있다.
items.title_en: Success at Aljezur's Cattery
items.title_ko: 알제주르 고양이 보호소, 첫 행사 성공
items.title_original: Success at Aljezur’s Cattery

items.raw_excerpt: KHON KAEN - Land officials in Khon Kaen have amended details on a title deed to recognise Wat Pa Adulyaram as the rightful holder, resolving a bitter dispute with the heirs of the man who donated the land more than three decades ago.
items.summary_en: Land officials in Khon Kaen fixed a title deed to name Wat Pa Adulyaram as the rightful owner of donated land. The change settles a long fight with the donor's heirs that lasted more than thirty years.
items.summary_ko: 콘깬 지역 토지 담당자가 왓 파 아둘야람 사찰을 토지의 정당한 소유자로 인정하도록 등기부를 바로잡았습니다. 이번 변경으로 30년 넘게 이어져 온 기증자 후손들과의 다툼이 마무리됐습니다.
items.title_en: Temple wins land deed battle in Khon Kaen
items.title_ko: 콘깬 사찰 토지 분쟁, 등기 명의 바로잡혀 끝나
items.title_original: Deed amendment brings end to Khon Kaen temple land dispute

items.raw_excerpt: La ley de plásticos de un solo uso impide a fonderos celebrar las Fiestas Patrias generando menos residuos. No se podrá entregar vasos, platos, cubiertos, bombillas y envases plásticos de un solo uso, y deberán existir mecanismos para su reutilización, reciclaje o compostaje.
items.summary_en: Chilean Independence Day food stalls called fondas will no longer use single-use plastic cups, plates, or cutlery. A new law requires reusable, recyclable, or compostable options. Breaking the rule can bring heavy fines.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 국경일 축제 음식점인 '푼다'에서는 일회용 플라스틱 컵, 접시, 수저를 더 이상 쓸 수 없게 된다. 새 법은 재사용하거나 재활용, 퇴비화가 가능한 용기를 쓰도록 요구한다. 이를 어기면 큰 벌금을 물 수 있다.
items.title_en: Chile's fondas face new plastic cup ban
items.title_ko: 칠레 국경일 푼다, 플라스틱 컵 금지된다
items.title_original: Fondas sin vasos plásticos: Nueva ley impone severas multas

items.raw_excerpt: A popular sign in one of Perth's busiest thoroughfares is damaged in a blaze, which is quickly extinguished.
items.summary_en: A popular sign in one of Perth's busiest streets was damaged in a fire. The fire at Yagan Square was quickly put out.
items.summary_ko: 퍼스에서 가장 붐비는 거리 중 하나에 있는 인기 간판이 불에 타 손상됐습니다. 야간 스퀘어에서 발생한 불은 빠르게 진압됐습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Scientists from CMFRI describe a new conger eel species, Ariosoma cmfriense, discovered in the Arabian Sea.
items.summary_en: Scientists in India found a new eel species in the Arabian Sea. They named it Ariosoma cmfriense after the research institute CMFRI. The discovery adds new knowledge about the sea life near Kerala.
items.summary_ko: 인도 과학자들이 아라비아 해에서 새 장어 종을 발견했습니다. 발견된 종은 인도 연구소 시엠에프알아이의 이름을 따서 이름 지어졌습니다. 이번 발견은 케랄라 연안 바다 생물에 대한 새로운 지식을 더해 주고 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: O Música no Museu começa nesta quarta-feira no Rio de Janeiro, com o 21° RioHarpFestival, às 12h30.
items.summary_en: A music program called Music in the Museum returns to the National Museum of Fine Arts in Rio de Janeiro after eight years. It opens this Wednesday at 12:30 with the 21st Rio Harp Festival.

items.raw_excerpt: Drehen Sie die Musik auf mit diesen DJ-Sets von Frauen, die die Techno- und Electro-Szene ordentlich aufmischen. Ob feste Größen oder aufstrebende Stars, diese Shows laden dazu ein, ihre Arbeit in vollen Zügen zu genießen. Lassen Sie sich von ihren Beats und ihrer Kreativität mitreißen - so wie auch ihr Publikum vor Ort.

items.raw_excerpt: The first phase of the York Village Revitalization Project will improve sidewalks.
items.summary_en: A 4.1 million dollar project to improve York Village has started. The first phase will fix and improve sidewalks. The work is part of a plan to make the village nicer for residents and visitors.

items.raw_excerpt: Here's a phrase that's worth keeping handy.
items.summary_en: Alla mano literally means 'at hand'. Italians use it to describe a person who is friendly and easy to talk to. It is a useful phrase for everyday conversation.

items.raw_excerpt: A Vienna raid has put the rules around cosmetic injections back in the spotlight. So how can you check whether the person treating you is actually authorised to do so in Austria?
items.summary_en: A police raid in Vienna put cosmetic injection rules in the spotlight. The article explains how to check if your doctor or clinic is legally allowed to give Botox and fillers.
items.summary_ko: 빈에서 벌어진 경찰 단속 덕분에 성형 시술 규정이 다시 주목받고 있습니다. 시술하는 의사나 병원이 법적으로 시술 자격이 있는지 확인하는 방법을 소개합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Stunning scenes of the world through microscopes have been put on display by the Nikon Small World In Motion competition winners.
items.summary_en: The Nikon Small World in Motion contest shared the best microscopic videos of the year. The winners filmed tiny cells, small creatures, and nature scenes up close. The clips reveal a hidden world that is too small to see with the naked eye.

items.title_en: Winners of a microscopic video contest show a dazzling tiny world

items.raw_excerpt: Maradu water treatment plant will boost Kochi's water supply by 20 MLD, enhancing production capacity and infrastructure.
items.summary_en: Work on the Maradu water treatment plant is done. It will add 20 MLD of water to Kochi's supply. This will boost production and improve the city's water infrastructure.
items.summary_ko: 마라두 정수장 공사가 완료됐다. 이 시설은 코치의 물 공급량을 하루 20MLD만큼 늘려줄 예정이다. 생산 능력과 상수도 기반 시설이 함께 개선될 전망이다.
items.title_en: New water plant will add more water to Kochi
items.title_ko: 마라두 정수장, 코치 물 공급 20MLD 추가
items.title_original: Maradu water treatment plant set to add 20 MLD to Kochi water supply
